versions.changelog:
- Clarified the skill description to include reviews along with recommendations, comparisons, and purchase advice.
- Fixed minor typos and improved description readability.
- No changes to API or functionality—documentation only.

Criticaster 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Aggregates professional product reviews and normalizes scores to easily rank and compare products across categories.
- Supports fast keyword search and deep semantic search for finding the best product recommendations, comparisons, and purchase advice.
- Provides detailed product information, including pros and cons and full review lists with source attribution.
- Allows browsing pre-computed “best of” product lists by category and price tier (value, premium, budget, discovery).
- Enables users to request new products or categories, upvote existing requests, and verify actions via email.
